title: Generations Hall

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Generations Hall is the ideal location for your next workplace gathering! Whether it’s a holiday party, annual conference, or company luncheon, we offer customized packages to fit your needs. With over 8 full service bars, and catering packages, we have ample space to fit your VIP guests. Your team building doesn’t have to stop at Generations Hall. Add a little fun to your team building events when you book with us! Conveniently located in the center of downtown New Orleans, Generations Hall is only blocks away from some of the best educational must-sees in town. Company workshops and seminars at Generations Hall are set behind the creative and artistic backdrop of the city of New Orleans.
